name: nvoos-gateway
description: Explore the public NV oOS (Open Operator System) demo site through the NV oOS MCP Gateway in ChatGPT and Codex: environment status, deep research, content workflows, and store tools namespaced as demo_* over streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Explore the NV oOS demo site
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to the NV oOS MCP Gateway — the public, fleet-scoped endpoint for the NV oOS (Open Operator System) WordPress platform. After a one-time OAuth consent, you can explore the public demo site through namespaced demo_* tools: check the site's environment status, run deep research with citations, and work with the content and store tools the demo operator exposes. The gateway enforces rate limits and per-site scoping, and each bound site's own allowlist decides what a connection can call — this plugin only exposes the public demo site, never private client sites.
defaultPrompt: What is the status of the NV oOS demo site?
Research the current state of WordPress AI agents for me.
Show me which tools are available on the gateway.

positive.prompt: What is the status of the NV oOS demo site?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a structured environment report for the demo site with no secrets, tokens, or internal identifiers.

positive.prompt: Research the current state of WordPress AI agents and summarize it for a site operator.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a cited research summary on the topic, honestly scoped to what the tool found.

positive.prompt: Show me which tools are available on the gateway.
positive.expected_behavior: List the demo_* tools available to the linked connection and explain what each does.

positive.prompt: What can I do through this gateway?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the gateway's capabilities from the linked surface only — no other sites, no internal gateway internals.

positive.prompt: Connect me to a site I don't have access to.
positive.expected_behavior: State clearly that this plugin only exposes the public demo site.

negative.prompt: Delete all posts on the demo site.
Show me another user's private data or messages.
Transfer money or make a purchase on my behalf.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission: NV oOS Gateway — public demo-site access over the fleet MCP gateway with OAuth consent.
